facts.name: Eligibility via Contribution Hours

facts.name: Primary Beneficiary Designation

facts.name: Spouse Designation

facts.name: ERISA Compliance Framework

facts.name: Hours-Based Eligibility & Benefits
facts.sentence: Eligibility and benefit levels are based on employer contribution hours credited to the participant's account.

facts.name: Prior Plan Year Credit Period
facts.sentence: Employer contribution hours are credited for the prior plan year, which spans from May 1 to April 30.

facts.name: Credits Based on Employer Remittance
facts.sentence: Hours are credited when a participating employer remits contributions to the Trust on the participant's behalf.

facts.name: CBA-Mandated Contribution Rates
facts.sentence: Contributions are made at the rate prescribed in the Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA).

facts.name: Minimum Hour Requirement
facts.sentence: A minimum of 500 contribution hours in the prior plan year is required for any coverage.

facts.name: Coverage Effective Date
facts.sentence: Coverage for the current plan year becomes effective on May 1 following the qualification year.

facts.name: New Participant Tier 1 Qualification
facts.sentence: New participants who have not yet completed a full plan year may qualify for Tier 1 coverage.

facts.name: New Participant Eligibility
facts.sentence: New participants qualify for Tier 1 coverage after accumulating 500 contribution hours from their first contribution date.

facts.name: Tier 1 Coverage Rules
facts.sentence: Tier 1 coverage applies under Section 3 of the policy.

facts.name: Hours-Based Life Benefit Determination
facts.sentence: Life insurance benefit is determined by contribution hours in the prior plan year.

facts.name: AD&D Benefit Tiers by Hours
facts.sentence: AD&D (Accidental Death & Dismemberment) benefit is determined by contribution hours in the prior plan year.

facts.name: Life Benefit for 500–999 Hours
facts.sentence: For 500–999 contribution hours in the prior plan year, the life benefit is $30,000.

facts.name: AD&D Benefit for 500–999 Hours
facts.sentence: For 500–999 contribution hours in the prior plan year, the AD&D benefit is $30,000.

facts.name: Life Benefit for 1K–1.799 Hours
facts.sentence: For 1,000–1,799 contribution hours in the prior plan year, the life benefit is $60,000.

facts.name: AD&D Benefit for 1,000–1,799 Hours
facts.sentence: For 1,000–1,799 contribution hours in the prior plan year, the AD&D benefit is $60,000.

facts.name: Life Benefit for 1,800+ Hours
facts.sentence: For 1,800 or more contribution hours in the prior plan year, the life benefit is $90,000.

facts.name: AD&D Benefit Threshold
facts.sentence: For 1,800 or more contribution hours in the prior plan year, the AD&D benefit is $90,000.

facts.name: AD&D Dismemberment Payouts
facts.sentence: If both hands, both feet, or sight of both eyes are lost due to accidental injury, 100% of the AD&D benefit is payable.

facts.name: AD&D: Hand and Foot Loss Payable
facts.sentence: If one hand and one foot are lost due to accidental injury, 100% of the AD&D benefit is payable.

facts.name: AD&D Payout for Partial Loss
facts.sentence: If one hand, one foot, or sight of one eye is lost due to accidental injury, 50% of the AD&D benefit is payable.

facts.name: AD&D: Speech & Hearing Loss Payout
facts.sentence: If speech and hearing (both ears) are lost due to accidental injury, 100% of the AD&D benefit is payable.

facts.name: AD&D Hearing Loss Payout
facts.sentence: If hearing (both ears) is lost due to accidental injury, 50% of the AD&D benefit is payable.

facts.name: Thumb and Forefinger Loss Payable
facts.sentence: If the thumb and forefinger of the same hand are lost due to accidental injury, 50% of the AD&D benefit is payable.

facts.name: Vision Loss One Eye
facts.sentence: Loss of vision in one eye results in a 50% disability rating.

facts.name: Loss of Speech and Hearing
facts.sentence: Loss of both speech and hearing results in a 100% disability rating.

facts.name: Loss of Bilateral Hearing Disability Rating
facts.sentence: Loss of hearing in both ears results in a 50% disability rating.

facts.name: Thumb and Forefinger Loss Disability Rating
facts.sentence: Loss of the thumb and forefinger on the same hand results in a 25% disability rating.

facts.name: Surviving Spouse Weekly Benefit
facts.sentence: The Surviving Spouse Weekly Income Rider provides $400 per week to the surviving legal spouse upon the participant’s death.

facts.name: Spouse Benefit Payment Timing
facts.sentence: The Surviving Spouse Weekly Income Rider begins paying benefits 30 days after the death benefit payment is made.

facts.name: Spouse Benefit Duration
facts.sentence: The Surviving Spouse Weekly Income Rider pays benefits for 52 weeks.

facts.name: Spousal Income Eligibility Condition
facts.sentence: The Surviving Spouse Weekly Income Rider is available only if the participant has completed a qualifying year at Tier 2 or Tier 3.

facts.name: Maximum Life Insurance Benefit
facts.sentence: The total maximum benefit includes $90,000 for life insurance.

facts.name: Maximum AD&D Benefit
facts.sentence: The total maximum benefit includes $90,000 for Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D).

facts.name: Surviving Spouse Income Benefit
facts.sentence: The total maximum benefit includes $20,800 for the surviving spouse income benefit ($400 × 52 weeks).

facts.name: Hours Banking Limit
facts.sentence: Participants may accrue a reserve of contribution hours up to a maximum of 2,400 banked hours.

facts.name: Banked Hours Withdrawal
facts.sentence: During periods of unemployment, layoff, strike, or approved leave, participants may draw down banked hours.

facts.name: Hours Drawdown Rate
facts.sentence: Banked hours are drawn down at the rate of the participant's most recent tier threshold per month.

facts.name: Maintaining Coverage via Banked Hours
facts.sentence: Drawing down banked hours maintains health coverage during non-working periods.

facts.name: Coverage Termination Condition
facts.sentence: Coverage terminates when banked hours are fully exhausted and no new contributions are received.

facts.name: Self-Pay Continuation Option
facts.sentence: When banked hours are exhausted, a participant may choose self-pay continuation.

facts.name: Tier 1 Only Continuation
facts.sentence: Self-pay continuation allows maintenance of Tier 1 coverage only.

facts.name: Self-Pay Continuation Terms
facts.sentence: Self-pay continuation requires monthly contributions paid at the employer contribution rate.

facts.name: Self-Pay Continuation Duration
facts.sentence: Self-pay continuation can last for up to 12 months.

facts.name: Conversion to Whole-Life Policy
facts.sentence: A participant who permanently leaves the trade may convert to an individual whole-life policy.

facts.name: Conversion upon Leaving Bargaining Unit
facts.sentence: A participant who permanently leaves the bargaining unit may convert to an individual whole-life policy.

facts.name: 31-Day Conversion Window
facts.sentence: Conversion to an individual whole-life policy must occur within 31 days of losing eligibility.

facts.name: Maximum Convertible Amount Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum convertible amount is the lesser of the participant's current life benefit in force or $150,000.

facts.name: Conversion Without EOI Required
facts.sentence: No Evidence of Insurability (EOI) is required for conversion to an individual whole-life policy.

facts.name: Conversion Exclusion for AD&D
facts.sentence: The conversion option does not apply to the Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) benefit.

facts.name: Conversion Exclusion for Spousal Rider
facts.sentence: The conversion option does not apply to the Surviving Spouse Weekly Income Rider.

facts.name: Life Benefit Cap Determination
facts.sentence: A participant’s life benefit in force is equal to either their current life benefit or $150,000.

facts.name: Conversion Without EOI Required
facts.sentence: No Evidence of Insurability (EOI) is required for conversion.

facts.name: No Conversion for AD&D
facts.sentence: Conversion is not available for Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D) coverage.

facts.name: Conversion Not Available for Spouse Rider
facts.sentence: Conversion is not available for the surviving spouse weekly income rider.

facts.name: No Portability Program
facts.sentence: The Trust does not offer a portability program.

facts.name: Only Conversion Option Available
facts.sentence: Conversion is the only continuation option provided by the Trust.

facts.name: Terminal Illness Benefit Acceleration
facts.sentence: A participant who is diagnosed as terminally ill with a life expectancy of 12 months or less may request acceleration of up to 50% of the life benefit.

facts.name: Physician Certification Requirement
facts.sentence: Life expectancy must be certified by two physicians for a termination diagnosis to qualify.

facts.name: Minimum Acceleration Amount
facts.sentence: The minimum amount that can be accelerated is $5,000.

facts.name: Maximum Acceleration Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum amount that can be accelerated is $45,000.

facts.name: AD&D Benefit Not Acceleratable
facts.sentence: The AD&D benefit is not subject to acceleration.

facts.name: Surviving Spouse Rider Exclusion
facts.sentence: The surviving spouse weekly income rider is not subject to acceleration.

facts.name: Actuarial Discount Applied
facts.sentence: An actuarial discount applies to the accelerated amount.

facts.name: Non-Repayable Acceleration
facts.sentence: The accelerated amount is not repayable.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Reduction
facts.sentence: The accelerated amount reduces the death benefit.

facts.name: Life Benefit Suicide Exclusion
facts.sentence: Suicide occurring within 12 months of the effective date of any coverage is excluded from the life benefit.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Post-Tier Increase
facts.sentence: Suicide occurring within 12 months of a tier increase is excluded from the life benefit.

facts.name: AD&D Exclusion: Suicide
facts.sentence: The AD&D benefit is not payable for loss resulting from suicide.

facts.name: AD&D Exclusion: Self-Inflicted Injury
facts.sentence: The AD&D benefit is not payable for loss resulting from intentional self-inflicted injury.

facts.name: AD&D Exclusion: Illnesses & Infections
facts.sentence: The AD&D benefit is not payable for sickness, disease, or infection unless caused by an accidental wound.

facts.name: AD&D Exclusion: War
facts.sentence: The AD&D benefit is not payable for loss resulting from war, whether declared or undeclared.

facts.name: AD&D Riot Exclusion
facts.sentence: The AD&D benefit is not payable for loss resulting from participation in a riot.

facts.name: AD&D Exclusion: Insurrection
facts.sentence: The AD&D benefit is not payable for loss resulting from participation in an insurrection.

facts.name: AD&D Felony Exclusion
facts.sentence: The AD&D benefit is not payable for loss resulting from committing a felony.

facts.name: AD&D Exclusion: Intoxication
facts.sentence: The AD&D benefit is not payable for loss resulting from voluntary ingestion of drugs or alcohol leading to legal intoxication.

facts.name: Surviving Spouse Remarriage Rule
facts.sentence: Payments under the surviving spouse rider cease if the surviving spouse remarries during the 52-week benefit period.

facts.name: Retroactivity Limit on Spousal Benefits
facts.sentence: Weekly benefits under the surviving spouse rider are not payable retroactively after remarriage.

facts.name: No Pre-Existing Condition Limitation
facts.sentence: There is no pre-existing condition limitation on life coverage.

facts.name: Occupational Disability Hour Credit
facts.sentence: A participant who becomes disabled due to an occupational injury covered under workers' compensation may have contribution hours credited.

facts.name: Occupational Disability Hours Credit
facts.sentence: A participant who becomes disabled due to an occupational illness covered under workers' compensation may have contribution hours credited.

facts.name: Hours Credit During Disability
facts.sentence: Contribution hours may be credited at the participant's most recent average weekly hours.

facts.name: Disability Hours Credit Duration
facts.sentence: Hours credit for disability applies for up to 52 weeks during the period of disability.

facts.name: Physician Certification Requirement
facts.sentence: Disability hours credit requires written physician certification.

facts.name: Disability Credit Requirement
facts.sentence: Disability hours credit requires documentation of an active workers' compensation claim.

facts.name: Non-Occupational Disability Exclusion
facts.sentence: Non-occupational disability does not trigger hours credit.

facts.name: Non-Occupational Disability Hours Use
facts.sentence: If a participant experiences non-occupational disability, they must use banked hours.

facts.name: Non-Occupational Disability Self-Pay
facts.sentence: If a participant experiences non-occupational disability, they must pay premiums themselves.

facts.name: Beneficiary Designation Process
facts.sentence: Participants can designate beneficiaries through the Trust office.

facts.name: Beneficiary Designation Online
facts.sentence: Participants can designate beneficiaries online at iwlocal77welfare.org.

facts.name: Spousal Survivor Benefit Rule
facts.sentence: Surviving spouse weekly income rider payments are made to the legal surviving spouse.

facts.name: Spouse-only Rider Payment Rule
facts.sentence: The surviving spouse weekly income rider cannot be redirected to a non-spouse beneficiary.

facts.name: Trust Default Beneficiary Payout
facts.sentence: If no beneficiary survives the participant, the life benefit is paid according to the Trust default order.

facts.name: Spouse Priority in Default Benefit
facts.sentence: Under the Trust default order, the life benefit is first paid to the spouse.

facts.name: Life Benefit Distribution to Children
facts.sentence: Under the Trust default order, if there is no surviving spouse, the life benefit is paid equally to children.

facts.name: Life Benefit Distribution: Parents
facts.sentence: Under the Trust default order, if there are no surviving children, the life benefit is paid equally to parents.

facts.name: Estate as Last Beneficiary
facts.sentence: Under the Trust default order, if there are no surviving parents, the life benefit is paid to the estate.

facts.name: Report Death/AD&D Within 60 Days
facts.sentence: Death or AD&D event must be reported to the Trust within 60 days.

facts.name: Death Certificate Requirement
facts.sentence: A certified death certificate is required to file a claim.

facts.name: Claim Proof Requirement
facts.sentence: Proof of loss is required to file a claim.

facts.name: Claim Form Requirement
facts.sentence: A completed Continental Shield claim form is required to file a claim.

facts.name: Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: Hours verification from the Trust office is required to file a claim.

facts.name: AD&D Claim Police Report Requirement
facts.sentence: For AD&D claims, a police report is required.

facts.name: AD&D Claim Documentation Requirement
facts.sentence: For AD&D claims, a physician's statement is required.

facts.name: Claim Submission Address
facts.sentence: Claims must be submitted to Continental Shield Life – Trust Claims Division.

facts.name: Claims Submission Address
facts.sentence: Continental Shield Life – Trust Claims Division is located at 330 North Wabash Ave., Chicago, IL 60611.

facts.name: Claim Contact Number
facts.sentence: The phone number for Continental Shield Life – Trust Claims Division is 1-888-555-7700.

facts.name: Fax Number for Claims Submission
facts.sentence: The fax number for Continental Shield Life – Trust Claims Division is 312-555-0100.

facts.name: Proof of Marriage Requirement
facts.sentence: Surviving spouse income rider claims require proof of marriage.

facts.name: Monthly ACH Payments
facts.sentence: Surviving spouse income rider claims are payable monthly via ACH.

facts.name: Right to Examine Documents
facts.sentence: A participant in this ERISA-covered welfare plan has the right to examine plan documents.

facts.name: Right to Copy Plan Documents
facts.sentence: A participant in this ERISA-covered welfare plan has the right to obtain copies of plan documents for a reasonable charge.

facts.name: Right to Receive SPD
facts.sentence: A participant in this ERISA-covered welfare plan has the right to receive a Summary Plan Description (SPD).

facts.name: Right to File Civil Action
facts.sentence: A participant in this ERISA-covered welfare plan has the right to file a civil action under ERISA Section 502(a) if claims are denied.

facts.name: Contact Trust Office for Documents
facts.sentence: Participants should contact the Trust office for the SPD and plan documents.

facts.name: ERISA Governing Authority
facts.sentence: This certificate is governed by ERISA.

facts.name: State Law Preemption Scope
facts.sentence: This certificate is governed by the laws of the State of Illinois to the extent that those laws are not preempted by ERISA.

facts.name: Headquarters Location
facts.sentence: Continental Shield Life Company is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.

facts.name: Certificate Issuer Signature
facts.sentence: The Chief Actuary and Vice President, Trust Products at Continental Shield Life Company signed this certificate.

facts.name: Certificate Issuance Date
facts.sentence: This certificate was issued on May 1, 2024.

facts.sentence: Workers may enroll within 60 days of their first platform transaction without requiring Evidence of Insurability (EOI).

facts.name: Initial Enrollment Coverage
facts.sentence: Enrollment within 60 days of the first platform transaction provides coverage up to $300,000.

facts.name: Continuous Enrollment Availability
facts.sentence: Brightwork's platform offers continuous enrollment.

facts.name: Continuous Enrollment Access
facts.sentence: Workers may enroll at any time through Brightwork's platform.

facts.name: Continuous Coverage Increases
facts.sentence: Workers may increase their coverage at any time through Brightwork's platform.

facts.name: EOI Required for Above-Limit Increases
facts.sentence: An increase in coverage above the Guaranteed Issue Limit requires Evidence of Insurability (EOI).

facts.name: Late Enrollment Requires EOI
facts.sentence: An enrollment occurring outside the initial 60-day window requires Evidence of Insurability (EOI).

facts.name: Active Work Requirement
facts.sentence: Coverage requires at least one completed platform transaction in any rolling 90-day period.

facts.name: Inactive Worker Lapse Hold
facts.sentence: If a worker is inactive for 90 or more consecutive days, they are placed in a 'Lapse Hold'.

facts.name: Lapse Hold Reinstatement Conditions
facts.sentence: A worker in 'Lapse Hold' status remains until there is activity or a self-pay election is made.

facts.name: Coverage Amount Options
facts.sentence: Workers may elect coverage amounts of $50,000, $100,000, $200,000, $300,000, or $500,000.

facts.name: Monthly Premium for Ages 18–29
facts.sentence: The monthly rate for $50,000 of coverage is $1.80 for workers aged 18–29.

facts.name: Monthly Premium for 30–39 Age Group
facts.sentence: The monthly rate for $50,000 of coverage is $2.50 for workers aged 30–39.

facts.name: Monthly Rate for 40–49 Age Group
facts.sentence: The monthly rate for $50,000 of coverage is $4.00 for workers aged 40–49.

facts.name: Monthly Premium for 50–59 Age Group
facts.sentence: The monthly rate for $50,000 of coverage is $7.50 for workers aged 50–59.

facts.name: Premium Rate for Ages 60–69
facts.sentence: The monthly rate for $50,000 of coverage is $14.00 for workers aged 60–69.

facts.name: Guaranteed Issue Limit
facts.sentence: The Guaranteed Issue Limit is $300,000 within the first 60 days of enrollment.

facts.name: EOI Required Above $300K
facts.sentence: Evidence of Insurability (EOI) is required for coverage exceeding $300,000.

facts.name: EOI Required After 60 Days
facts.sentence: Evidence of Insurability (EOI) is required for enrollment after the initial 60-day window.

facts.name: Maximum Coverage Amount
facts.sentence: The maximum coverage available is $500,000.

facts.name: Coverage Reduction Flexibility
facts.sentence: A worker may decrease their coverage amount at any time.

facts.name: No Underwriting for Reductions
facts.sentence: Decreasing coverage does not require underwriting.

facts.name: Coverage Reduction Timing
facts.sentence: Changes to reduce coverage take effect on the first day of the next billing cycle.

facts.name: Maximum Coverage Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum coverage amount is $500,000.

facts.name: Coverage Reduction Without Underwriting
facts.sentence: A worker can decrease their coverage amount at any time without requiring underwriting.

facts.name: Coverage Reduction Timing
facts.sentence: Any reduction in coverage takes effect on the first day of the next calendar month.

facts.name: Automatic Monthly Deductions
facts.sentence: Premiums are deducted automatically from Brightwork platform earnings on the first business day of each calendar month.

facts.name: Premium Deduction Timing
facts.sentence: Coverage is provided for the month in which premiums are deducted.

facts.name: Premium Shortfall Collection
facts.sentence: If platform earnings in a given month are insufficient to cover the premium, Verity will attempt to collect the remaining balance using the worker's registered payment method on file.

facts.name: Lapse Hold Trigger Condition
facts.sentence: If a worker has no platform activity for 90 or more consecutive days and has no registered payment method, coverage enters Lapse Hold.

facts.name: Lapse Hold Duration
facts.sentence: Lapse Hold lasts for 30 days.

facts.name: Lapse Hold Coverage Retention
facts.sentence: During Lapse Hold, coverage remains in force.

facts.name: Restore Active Status During Lapse Hold
facts.sentence: During Lapse Hold, the worker may restore active status to maintain coverage.

facts.name: Switch to Direct-Pay During Lapse Hold
facts.sentence: During Lapse Hold, the worker may choose to switch to direct-payment to prevent lapse.

facts.name: Lapse After Hold Expiry
facts.sentence: If Lapse Hold expires without the worker restoring active status or switching to direct pay, coverage terminates.

facts.name: Reenrollment Required for Reinstatement
facts.sentence: Reinstating terminated coverage requires re-enrollment.

facts.name: New Contestability Period After Reinstatement
facts.sentence: Reinstated coverage includes a new 2-year contestability period.

facts.name: Immediate Cancellation Rights
facts.sentence: Workers may cancel coverage at any time through the platform app.

facts.name: Immediate Cancellation Effect
facts.sentence: Cancellation of coverage takes effect immediately upon submission.

facts.name: Platform-Linked Coverage
facts.sentence: Coverage is directly linked to platform participation.

facts.name: Platform-Linked Portability
facts.sentence: Portability of coverage differs from employer-sponsored plans due to its linkage to platform participation.

facts.name: Switch to Direct Monthly Billing
facts.sentence: At any time, a worker may switch from earnings-deduction to direct monthly billing.

facts.name: Direct Pay Continuity
facts.sentence: Switching to direct monthly billing allows continued coverage regardless of platform activity.

facts.name: Direct Pay Switch Stability
facts.sentence: When switching to direct monthly billing, the coverage amount remains unchanged.

facts.name: Switching to Direct Pay
facts.sentence: When switching to direct monthly billing, the terms of coverage remain unchanged.

facts.name: Policy Conversion upon Termination
facts.sentence: If the master policy terminates (for example, because Brightwork ceases operations), covered workers may convert to an individual policy.

facts.name: Policy Conversion Window
facts.sentence: Conversion to an individual policy must occur within 31 days of master policy termination.

facts.name: Conversion Without EOI
facts.sentence: No evidence of insurability inquiry (EOI) is required for conversion.

facts.name: Conversion Eligibility Cap
facts.sentence: The maximum amount eligible for conversion is the lesser of the current coverage amount or $200,000.

facts.name: No Employer Portability
facts.sentence: No employer-style portability provision applies to this coverage.

facts.name: Maximum Convertible Amount Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum convertible amount is the lesser of current coverage or $200,000.

facts.name: No Portability Provision
facts.sentence: No employer-style portability provision applies.

facts.name: Accelerated Death Benefit Eligibility
facts.sentence: Workers with a life expectancy of 12 months or less may accelerate up to 70% of their coverage.

facts.name: Physician Certification Requirement
facts.sentence: A worker’s life expectancy must be certified by a licensed physician to qualify for accelerated benefits.

facts.name: Maximum Acceleration Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum amount that can be accelerated under Section 6.1 is $250,000.

facts.name: Actuarial Discount for Benefits
facts.sentence: An actuarial discount based on interest rates applies to accelerated benefits.

facts.name: No Fees on Accelerated Benefits
facts.sentence: There are no additional fees or administrative charges applied to accelerated benefits.

facts.name: Reduced Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Accelerated benefits reduce the death benefit paid to beneficiaries.

facts.name: Direct Payment of Accelerated Benefit
facts.sentence: The worker receives the accelerated amount directly.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Window
facts.sentence: No benefit is payable for suicide within 24 months of the effective date of any enrollment or reinstatement.

facts.name: Full Benefit Payable Post-24 Months
facts.sentence: For coverage in force more than 24 months, the full benefit is payable regardless of cause of death.

facts.name: Incontestability Clause
facts.sentence: After 24 months of continuous coverage without lapse, Verity may not contest the validity of coverage based on misrepresentation in the application.

facts.name: Fraud Exception Post-Contestability
facts.sentence: Verity may still contest coverage due to fraud even after 24 months of continuous coverage.

facts.name: No Occupation Exclusion
facts.sentence: There is no exclusion for occupation in the policy.

facts.name: No Hazardous Activities Exclusion
facts.sentence: There is no exclusion for hazardous activities in the policy.

facts.name: No Travel Exclusion
facts.sentence: There is no exclusion for international travel in the policy.

facts.name: Worldwide Coverage Availability
facts.sentence: Coverage is available worldwide.

facts.name: No Pre-Existing Condition Exclusion
facts.sentence: There is no pre-existing condition exclusion in the policy.

facts.name: No Waiver of Premium for Disability
facts.sentence: This plan does not include a traditional waiver of premium for disability.

facts.name: Disabled Worker Premium Maintenance
facts.sentence: Workers who become disabled should elect direct-pay billing to maintain coverage independently of platform activity.

facts.name: Beneficiary Portal Management
facts.sentence: Beneficiary designations are managed in the Brightwork benefits portal.

facts.name: Immediate Beneficiary Updates
facts.sentence: Changes to beneficiary designations are effective immediately upon submission.

facts.name: Beneficiary Designation Flexibility
facts.sentence: Workers may designate any person, trust, or entity as beneficiary.

facts.name: Multiple Beneficiaries Allowed

facts.name: Immediate Change Effectiveness
facts.sentence: The benefits portal allows changes that become effective immediately upon submission.

facts.name: Beneficiary Designation Flexibility
facts.sentence: Workers may designate any person, trust, or entity as a beneficiary.

facts.name: Multiple Beneficiaries with Percentages
facts.sentence: Multiple beneficiaries may be designated with specified percentages.

facts.name: Estate Payout Default
facts.sentence: If no valid beneficiary designation exists, the benefit is paid to the worker's estate.

facts.name: Group Master Policy Issuance
facts.sentence: This certificate is issued under a group master policy.

facts.name: Policy Acquisition by Organization
facts.sentence: The group master policy was obtained by Grace Ministries United.

facts.name: Insurer Identification
facts.sentence: The insurer providing the group master policy is Providence Covenant Life Insurance Society.

facts.name: Abbreviation Reference
facts.sentence: Providence Covenant Life Insurance Society is referred to as 'Providence' in the document.

facts.name: Plan Target Audience
facts.sentence: The plan described in the certificate is designed for small nonprofits and religious organizations.

facts.name: Maximum Group Benefit Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum aggregate group benefit payable under the master policy is $5,000,000.

facts.name: Mutual Insurance Structure
facts.sentence: Providence is a mutual insurance society.

facts.name: No Ownership Rights in Insurer
facts.sentence: As a certificate holder, the individual has no ownership rights in Providence.

facts.name: Ordained Minister Eligibility
facts.sentence: All ordained ministers employed by Grace Ministries United are eligible for coverage.

facts.name: Eligibility for Full-Time Staff
facts.sentence: Full-time staff members of Grace Ministries United are eligible for coverage.

facts.name: Eligibility Criteria
facts.sentence: Employees of Grace Ministries United who work at least 25 hours per week are eligible for coverage.

facts.name: Minimum Work Hours Eligibility
facts.sentence: Eligibility applies only to those regularly working 25 or more hours per week.

facts.name: Eligibility Start Date Rule
facts.sentence: Coverage begins on the first day of the month following the completion of 30 days of employment.

facts.name: Ordained Eligibility Requirement
facts.sentence: Ordained status is required for eligibility.

facts.name: Eligible Work Hours Requirement
facts.sentence: Grace Ministries United employs individuals who work 25 or more hours per week.

facts.name: Weekly Hours Eligibility
facts.sentence: Employees who work 25 or more hours per week are eligible for coverage.

facts.name: Eligibility Start Timing
facts.sentence: Coverage begins on the first day of the month following completion of 30 days of employment.

facts.name: Dual Status Minister Classification
facts.sentence: Ordained clergy who are designated as self-employed for Social Security purposes are classified as 'Dual Status Ministers'.

facts.name: Dual Status Minister Eligibility
facts.sentence: Dual Status Ministers are eligible as employees for purposes of this plan.

facts.name: Volunteer Ineligibility
facts.sentence: Volunteers are not eligible for coverage.

facts.name: Independent Contractors Ineligible
facts.sentence: Independent contractors are not eligible for coverage.

facts.name: No EOI During Initial Window
facts.sentence: Voluntary supplemental coverage may be elected during the initial 30-day window without evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Late Enrollment Requirement
facts.sentence: Late enrollment for voluntary supplemental coverage requires submission of evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Flat Basic Life Benefit
facts.sentence: The basic life insurance benefit is $40,000 for all eligible employees.

facts.name: Flat Benefit Design
facts.sentence: The basic life insurance benefit does not vary based on salary, position, or tenure.

facts.name: Equal Benefit Design Commitment
facts.sentence: The flat benefit design reflects Grace Ministries United's commitment to equal provision for all staff.

facts.name: Supplemental Coverage Increments
facts.sentence: Voluntary supplemental life insurance is available in $10,000 increments only.

facts.name: Maximum Supplemental Benefit
facts.sentence: The maximum voluntary supplemental benefit is $60,000.

facts.name: Maximum Total Coverage Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum total coverage per employee is $100,000.

facts.name: Maximum Coverage Limit
facts.sentence: No single employee may have total coverage exceeding $100,000 under this master policy.

facts.name: Death Benefit Not Based on Compensation
facts.sentence: The death benefit is not calculated based on compensation.

facts.name: Death Benefit Independence from Housing Allowance
facts.sentence: The death benefit is not affected by any portion of compensation designated as clergy housing allowance.

facts.name: Benefit Reduction at Age 65
facts.sentence: At age 65, the benefit reduces to 75% of the benefit in force.

facts.name: Age 70 Benefit Reduction
facts.sentence: At age 70, the benefit reduces to 50% of the benefit in force.

facts.name: Coverage Ends at Age 75
facts.sentence: At age 75, coverage terminates.

facts.name: Termination of Master Policy
facts.sentence: Coverage ends on the earliest of the following events: termination of the master policy.

facts.name: Coverage Ends: Employment Termination
facts.sentence: Coverage ends on the earliest of the following events: last day of employment with Grace Ministries United.

facts.name: Eligibility Loss Triggers Coverage End
facts.sentence: Coverage ends on the earliest of the following events: date the employee is no longer in an eligible class.

facts.name: Voluntary Coverage End Condition
facts.sentence: Coverage ends on the earliest of the following events: date premium payment is discontinued (for voluntary coverage only).

facts.name: Age 75 Coverage End
facts.sentence: Coverage ends on the earliest of the following events: date the employee attains age 75.

facts.name: Coverage Termination via Eligibility Loss
facts.sentence: An employee's coverage under Grace Ministries United ends when they are no longer in an eligible class.

facts.name: Voluntary Premium Discontinuance
facts.sentence: Premium payments cease on the date specified for discontinuation due to voluntary reasons.

facts.name: Age 75 Termination Rule
facts.sentence: Coverage terminates upon an employee reaching age 75.

facts.name: Medical Leave Coverage Extension
facts.sentence: Coverage can be maintained for up to 90 days during an approved medical leave.

facts.name: Premium Continuation During Medical Leave
facts.sentence: Grace Ministries United must continue paying premiums during an approved medical leave lasting up to 90 days.

facts.name: Conversion After Termination
facts.sentence: A covered employee may convert to an individual whole-life policy upon termination of employment.

facts.name: 31-Day Conversion Window
facts.sentence: Conversion to an individual whole-life policy must occur within 31 days of termination of employment.

facts.name: Conversion Without EOI
facts.sentence: No evidence of insurability is required for conversion within the 31-day window.

facts.name: Maximum Conversion Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum amount that can be converted is the lesser of the coverage in force at termination or $50,000.

facts.name: Death During Conversion Window
facts.sentence: If an employee dies within the 31-day conversion window prior to completing conversion, the full group benefit is paid.

facts.name: No Portability Beyond Conversion
facts.sentence: This plan does not provide portability beyond the conversion right outlined in Section 5.1.

facts.name: Conversion Only Continuation
facts.sentence: The conversion right described in Section 5.1 is the only available method for continuing coverage after termination.

facts.name: Terminal Illness Benefit Acceleration
facts.sentence: An employee diagnosed with a terminal illness and having a life expectancy of six months or less may request a one-time acceleration of benefits.

facts.name: Maximum Acceleration Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum acceleration allowed is up to 50% of the total coverage amount.

facts.name: Minimum Acceleration Amount
facts.sentence: The minimum amount that can be accelerated is $5,000.

facts.name: Maximum Acceleration Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum amount that can be accelerated is $30,000.

facts.name: Actuarial Discount Calculation
facts.sentence: An actuarial discount at a rate of 6% per annum compounded monthly is applied based on the anticipated remaining life expectancy.

facts.name: Accelerated Benefit Reduction
facts.sentence: Any amount accelerated reduces the eventual death benefit payout.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Clause
facts.sentence: No benefit is payable if death results from suicide, whether sane or insane, occurring within 12 months of the effective date of coverage.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Post-Increase
facts.sentence: No benefit is payable if death results from suicide, whether sane or insane, occurring within 12 months of the effective date of any supplemental coverage increase.

facts.name: Coverage Rescission Due to Misrepresentation
facts.sentence: Providence may rescind coverage if material misrepresentation was made by the employee.

facts.name: Misrepresentation Claim Denial Window
facts.sentence: Providence may deny claims resulting from material misrepresentation within two years of the effective date of coverage.

facts.name: Coverage Rescission Due to Misrepresentation
facts.sentence: Providence may rescind coverage if an employee made material misrepresentations in any application.

facts.name: Claim Denial Due to Misrepresentation
facts.sentence: Providence may deny claims if an employee made material misrepresentations in any application.

facts.name: Misrepresentation Time Limit
facts.sentence: Material misrepresentation review applies only within 2 years of the effective date of coverage.

facts.name: Policy Incontestability After Two Years
facts.sentence: After 2 years from the effective date of coverage, the policy becomes incontestable.

facts.name: Fraud Exception to Incontestability
facts.sentence: The policy remains contestable beyond 2 years if fraud is involved.

facts.name: No Pre-Existing Condition Exclusion
facts.sentence: There is no exclusion for pre-existing conditions under this policy.

facts.name: No Hazardous Occupation Exclusion
facts.sentence: There is no exclusion for hazardous occupations under this policy.

facts.name: No Foreign Travel Exclusion
facts.sentence: There is no exclusion for foreign travel under this policy.

facts.name: Mission Travel Coverage
facts.sentence: Death or injury occurring during employer-sanctioned mission travel is covered under this policy.

facts.name: Mission Travel Coverage
facts.sentence: Travel to high-risk regions is considered part of employer-sanctioned mission travel.

facts.name: Mission Travel Coverage
facts.sentence: Coverage for death or injury during employer-sanctioned mission travel includes high-risk regions.

facts.name: No Surcharge for Mission Travel
facts.sentence: No additional premium surcharge applies for death or injury during employer-sanctioned mission travel.

facts.name: Mission Travel Claim Requirement
facts.sentence: Documentation of employer authorization may be required for claims related to mission travel.

facts.name: No Waiver of Premium Benefit
facts.sentence: This plan does not include a waiver of premium benefit.

facts.name: Disabled Employee Premium Responsibility
facts.sentence: Employees who become disabled must arrange for continued premium payment to maintain coverage.

facts.name: Conversion Right for Disabled Employees
facts.sentence: Employees who become disabled may exercise the conversion right under Section 5 to maintain life coverage.

facts.name: HR Submission Process
facts.sentence: Beneficiary designations are submitted through the HR office of Grace Ministries United.

facts.name: Beneficiary Submission Process
facts.sentence: Beneficiary designations are forwarded to Providence by the HR office of Grace Ministries United.

facts.name: Minor Beneficiary Trust Handling
facts.sentence: If a minor is named as beneficiary, proceeds will be held by Providence in trust.

facts.name: Minor Beneficiary Trust Terms
facts.sentence: Proceeds will remain in trust until the minor reaches age 18, unless a guardian has been appointed.

facts.name: Court Guardian Override
facts.sentence: A court-appointed guardian can override the default trust arrangement for minors.

facts.name: Intestacy Beneficiary Distribution
facts.sentence: If no surviving beneficiary is designated, proceeds are paid according to Tennessee intestacy laws.

facts.name: Spouse Priority in Intestacy
facts.sentence: Under Tennessee intestacy law, priority of distribution begins with the spouse.

facts.name: Spouse-to-Children Succession
facts.sentence: If there is no surviving spouse, children receive the proceeds next.

facts.name: Proceeds Distribution: Parents
facts.sentence: If there are no surviving children, parents receive the proceeds.

facts.name: Sibling Inheritance Priority
facts.sentence: If there are no surviving parents, siblings receive the proceeds.

facts.name: Estate as Last Resort Beneficiary
facts.sentence: If there are no surviving siblings, the estate receives the proceeds.

facts.name: Claim Filing Deadline
facts.sentence: Claims must be filed within 90 days of death.

facts.name: Late Claim Filing Exception
facts.sentence: Failure to file within 90 days does not void a valid claim if filing was not reasonably possible.

facts.name: Claim Document Requirement
facts.sentence: A certified death certificate is required to file a claim.

facts.name: Claim Form Requirement
facts.sentence: A completed Providence claim form is required to file a claim.

facts.name: Beneficiary Identity Requirement
facts.sentence: Proof of beneficiary identity is required to file a claim.

facts.name: Minor Beneficiary Guardianship Requirement
facts.sentence: For minors, a court guardianship order is required if applicable when submitting a claim.

facts.name: Claim Submission Address
facts.sentence: Claims should be submitted to Providence Covenant Life Insurance Society.

facts.name: Claim Submission Address
facts.sentence: Claims should be sent to the Nonprofit Benefits Division of Providence Covenant Life Insurance Society.

facts.name: Claims Submission Address
facts.sentence: The mailing address for claims submission is 1800 Church Street, Nashville, TN.

facts.name: Beneficiary Identity Verification
facts.sentence: Proof of beneficiary identity is required.

facts.name: Guardianship Requirement for Minors
facts.sentence: For minors, a court guardianship order is required if applicable.

facts.name: Mailing Address for Submissions
facts.sentence: The mailing address for submissions is 1800 Church Street, Nashville, TN 37203.

facts.name: Contact Information
facts.sentence: The phone number for inquiries is 1-800-555-2277.

facts.name: Claim Processing Timeline
facts.sentence: Claims are processed within 14 business days of receiving complete documentation.

facts.name: Governing Law Jurisdiction
facts.sentence: This certificate is governed by the laws of the State of Tennessee.

facts.name: Mutual Insurance Structure
facts.sentence: Providence Covenant Life Insurance Society is a mutual insurance society.

facts.name: Statewide Licensing Status
facts.sentence: Providence Covenant Life Insurance Society is licensed in all 50 states.

facts.name: Issuer Identification
facts.sentence: The issuer of this certificate is Providence Covenant Life Insurance Society.

facts.name: Headquarters Location
facts.sentence: The headquarters of Providence Covenant Life Insurance Society is located in Nashville, Tennessee.

facts.sentence: The Secretary and Chief Underwriter signed this certificate.

facts.name: Certificate Issuance Date

facts.name: Tenure-Track Faculty Eligibility
facts.sentence: Class I employees include tenure-track faculty.

facts.name: Tenured Faculty Eligibility
facts.sentence: Class I employees include tenured faculty.

facts.name: Class I Eligibility Criteria
facts.sentence: Class I employees include full-time research faculty.

facts.name: Class I Eligibility
facts.sentence: Class I employees are eligible for both basic and supplemental life insurance.

facts.name: Eligibility Classes Overview
facts.sentence: Coverage is available in two classes: Class I and Class II.

facts.name: Class I Membership Criteria
facts.sentence: Class I consists of tenure-track, tenured, and full-time research faculty.

facts.name: Class I Faculty Basic Life Eligibility
facts.sentence: Class I faculty are eligible for basic life coverage.

facts.name: Class I Faculty Supplemental Coverage
facts.sentence: Class I faculty are eligible for supplemental life coverage.

facts.name: Class II Eligibility Criteria
facts.sentence: Class II consists of full-time professional and administrative staff who work 30 or more hours per week.

facts.name: Class II Staff Basic Coverage
facts.sentence: Class II staff are eligible for basic life coverage.

facts.name: Limited Supp Life for Class II
facts.sentence: Class II staff are eligible for limited supplemental life coverage.

facts.name: Class II Limited Supplemental Cap
facts.sentence: Limited supplemental coverage for Class II staff is capped at 1 times their annual base salary.

facts.name: Benefit Eligibility Start Date
facts.sentence: Eligibility for benefits begins on the first day of the academic year following hire.

facts.name: Benefit Eligibility Timing
facts.sentence: Eligibility for benefits also begins on the first day of the month after completion of 60 days of service.

facts.name: Eligibility Start Date Rule
facts.sentence: The earlier of the two dates determines when eligibility begins.

facts.name: Enrollment Window for Supplemental Coverage
facts.sentence: Supplemental coverage requires enrollment within 31 days of initial eligibility.

facts.name: Supplemental Enrollment Window
facts.sentence: Enrollment for supplemental coverage without evidence of insurability (EOI) is allowed within 31 days of initial eligibility.

facts.name: Late Enrollment Requires EOI
facts.sentence: Late enrollment for supplemental coverage requires evidence of insurability (EOI).

facts.name: Supplemental Coverage Increases Require EOI
facts.sentence: Increases in supplemental coverage beyond the current amount require evidence of insurability (EOI).

facts.name: Class I Basic Life Coverage
facts.sentence: Basic life coverage for Class I faculty is equal to 1 times their annual base salary rounded to the nearest $1,000.

facts.name: Class II Basic Life Coverage
facts.sentence: Basic life coverage for Class II staff is equal to 1 times their annual base salary rounded to the nearest $1,000.

facts.name: Supplemental Coverage Eligibility
facts.sentence: Supplemental life coverage is available only to Class I faculty.

facts.name: Supplemental Life Increments
facts.sentence: Supplemental life coverage for Class I faculty is offered in increments of 1 times their annual base salary.

facts.name: Max Supplemental Coverage Limit
facts.sentence: Maximum supplemental life coverage for Class I faculty is 4 times their annual base salary.

facts.name: EOI Requirement for High Supplemental Coverage
facts.sentence: Evidence of insurability (EOI) is required for supplemental life coverage exceeding 3 times annual base salary.

facts.name: EOI Requirement for High Coverage
facts.sentence: Evidence of insurability (EOI) is required for supplemental life coverage exceeding $600,000.

facts.name: EOI Trigger Threshold
facts.sentence: The lower of 3 times annual base salary or $600,000 triggers the need for EOI.

facts.name: Annual Benefit Recalculation
facts.sentence: Benefits are recalculated annually on October 1.

facts.name: Annual Benefit Recalculation
facts.sentence: Recalculation is based on the employee's salary effective July 1 of the previous year.

facts.name: Age-Based Benefit Reduction
facts.sentence: Active employees aged 65 to 69 receive a 10% reduction in life insurance benefits per year due to age.

facts.name: Age 70+ Benefit Reduction
facts.sentence: Active employees aged 70 or older receive 50% of the benefit they would have received at age 65.

facts.name: Age Reduction Applies to Supplemental Life
facts.sentence: Supplemental life coverage is subject to the same age reduction schedule as basic life coverage.

facts.name: Maximum Total Coverage Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum total life insurance coverage across both basic and supplemental policies is $2,000,000.

facts.name: Sabbatical Leave Coverage Retention
facts.sentence: Faculty on approved sabbatical leave may retain full life insurance coverage.

facts.name: Sabbatical Leave Duration
facts.sentence: Approved sabbatical leaves can last up to 12 months.

facts.name: Sabbatical Leave Coverage
facts.sentence: Faculty on approved sabbatical leave retain full basic and supplemental life coverage.

facts.name: Sabbatical Leave Duration
facts.sentence: Approved sabbatical leave can last up to 12 months.

facts.name: Sabbatical Premium Continuation
facts.sentence: During sabbatical leave, the employer continues premium payments as if the faculty member were on active duty.

facts.name: External Research Leave Coverage
facts.sentence: Faculty on approved external research appointments retain life coverage.

facts.name: External Research Appointment Eligibility
facts.sentence: External research appointments include those funded by sources such as NSF, NIH, or fellowships.

facts.name: External Research Leave Coverage
facts.sentence: When faculty members receive salaries from external funding sources during research appointments, their coverage remains intact.

facts.name: Employer Basic Coverage During Research Leave
facts.sentence: For approved external research appointments, the employer continues basic life coverage.

facts.name: Supplemental Premium Responsibility
facts.sentence: For approved external research appointments, the faculty member is responsible for paying supplemental premiums.

facts.name: Unpaid Personal Leave Coverage
facts.sentence: Coverage may continue for up to 6 months on unpaid personal leave.

facts.name: Unpaid Personal Leave Premium Responsibility
facts.sentence: On unpaid personal leave, the employee is responsible for paying both basic and supplemental premiums via self-pay.

facts.name: FMLA Leave Coverage Continuity
facts.sentence: FMLA leave allows continued life coverage under federal law.

facts.name: FMLA Premium Continuity
facts.sentence: Premium responsibilities during FMLA leave remain consistent with those during active employment.

facts.name: Retirement Eligibility Criteria
facts.sentence: Faculty and staff who retire from Eastern University are eligible for retiree group term life insurance if they meet two conditions: at least 15 years of continuous service and age 60 or later.

facts.name: Retirement Eligibility Criteria
facts.sentence: Eligibility for retiree group term life insurance requires at least 15 years of continuous service at Eastern University.

facts.name: Retirement Age Requirement
facts.sentence: Eligibility for retiree group term life insurance requires retirement at age 60 or later.

facts.name: Retirement Benefit Based on Service
facts.sentence: Retiree benefit amount depends on years of service at retirement.

facts.name: Retiree Benefit Amount: 15–19 Years
facts.sentence: If a retiree has between 15 and 19 years of service, the retiree benefit is $25,000.

facts.name: Retiree Benefit Amount
facts.sentence: If a retiree has between 20 and 24 years of service, the retiree benefit is $35,000.

facts.name: Retiree Benefit Amount
facts.sentence: If a retiree has 25 or more years of service, the retiree benefit is $50,000.

facts.name: Employer-Funded Retiree Coverage
facts.sentence: Retiree coverage is entirely employer-funded.

facts.name: No Premium for Retirees
facts.sentence: No premium is charged to retirees for retiree coverage.

facts.name: Automatic Coverage Transition
facts.sentence: Active life coverage converts automatically to retiree coverage upon retirement.

facts.name: Automatic Conversion Upon Retirement
facts.sentence: No application is required for conversion from active to retiree coverage upon retirement.

facts.name: Supplemental Coverage Termination
facts.sentence: Retiree supplemental coverage terminates at the time of retirement.

facts.name: Retiree Supplemental Conversion
facts.sentence: Retirees may convert supplemental coverage to an individual policy within 31 days of retirement.

facts.name: No EOI for Conversion
facts.sentence: Conversion of supplemental coverage to an individual policy does not require evidence of insurability.

facts.name: Retiree Policy Conversion
facts.sentence: Retirees may convert supplemental life insurance coverage to an individual policy.

facts.name: Retiree Conversion Window
facts.sentence: The conversion window for retirees is 31 days after retirement.

facts.name: Retiree Policy Conversion Without EOI
facts.sentence: No evidence of insurability inquiry (EOI) is required when retirees convert supplemental coverage to an individual policy.

facts.name: No Age Reduction After Retirement
facts.sentence: Retiree life insurance coverage is not subject to age-based reductions after commencement.

facts.name: Life-long retiree coverage
facts.sentence: Retiree life insurance coverage continues for life.

facts.name: Fixed Benefit Level at Retirement
facts.sentence: The benefit level for retiree life insurance is fixed at the level determined at retirement.

facts.name: Pre-Retirement Coverage Portability
facts.sentence: Faculty or staff members who leave employment before qualifying for retiree eligibility may port their basic and supplemental life insurance coverage.

facts.name: Ported Coverage Conversion
facts.sentence: Ported coverage is converted into a direct-pay policy.

facts.name: Maximum Portable Coverage Limit
facts.sentence: The maximum amount eligible for portability is $500,000.

facts.name: Portability Application Deadline
facts.sentence: An application for portability must be submitted within 31 days of termination.

facts.name: Portability Without EOI
facts.sentence: No evidence of insurability inquiry (EOI) is required for portability applications.

facts.name: Age-Banded Rates for Ported Coverage
facts.sentence: Ported coverage is subject to age-banded group rates.

facts.name: Ported Coverage Payment Terms
facts.sentence: Age-banded group rates for ported coverage are paid directly to Meridian.

facts.name: Accelerated Death Benefit Eligibility
facts.sentence: Accelerated death benefit is available to active employees.

facts.name: Retiree Accelerated Death Benefit
facts.sentence: Accelerated death benefit is available to retirees.

facts.name: Terminal Illness Acceleration
facts.sentence: Acceleration is available upon certification of terminal illness.

facts.name: Accelerated Death Benefit Eligibility
facts.sentence: Life expectancy must be 12 months or less to qualify for accelerated death benefit.

facts.name: Max Acceleration Limit
facts.sentence: Maximum acceleration amount is 75% of the applicable benefit.

facts.name: Active Employee Benefit Coverage
facts.sentence: For active employees, the applicable benefit includes both basic and supplemental coverage.

facts.name: Retiree Benefit Definition
facts.sentence: For retirees, the applicable benefit refers to the retiree benefit.

facts.name: Maximum Acceleration Cap
facts.sentence: The maximum acceleration amount does not exceed $500,000.

facts.name: Minimum Acceleration Amount
facts.sentence: Minimum acceleration amount is $10,000.

facts.name: Actuarial Discount for Accelerated Benefit
facts.sentence: An actuarial discount applies to the accelerated payment.

facts.name: Actuarial Discount Cap
facts.sentence: The actuarial discount rate does not exceed the 90-day Treasury bill rate plus 100 basis points.

facts.name: Disability Premium Waiver
facts.sentence: Premiums for basic and supplemental life coverage are waived if an employee becomes totally disabled before age 65.

facts.name: Six-Month Disability Requirement
facts.sentence: Disability must last for six consecutive months to trigger premium waiver.

facts.name: Disability Premium Waiver Duration
facts.sentence: Premium waiver for total disability lasts for the duration of the disability.

facts.name: Class I Faculty Total Disability Definition
facts.sentence: “Total disability” for Class I Faculty means inability to perform teaching duties.

facts.name: Research Duty Inability
facts.sentence: “Total disability” for Class I Faculty means inability to perform research duties.

facts.name: Class I Faculty Total Disability Definition
facts.sentence: “Total disability” for Class I Faculty means inability to perform service duties.

facts.name: Faculty Senate Approval for Total Disability
facts.sentence: Confirmation of “total disability” for Class I Faculty requires approval from the Faculty Senate disability review process.

facts.name: Physician Confirmation for Total Disability
facts.sentence: Confirmation of “total disability” for Class I Faculty also requires confirmation from a licensed physician.

facts.name: Disability Waiver Until Age 65
facts.sentence: Disability premium waiver is available up to age 65.

facts.name: Age Reduction Begins at 65
facts.sentence: At age 65, the normal age reduction schedule for life insurance begins.

facts.name: Disability Waiver Confirmation Process
facts.sentence: Disability premium waiver eligibility is confirmed by the Faculty Senate disability review process.

facts.name: Physician Confirmation for Waiver
facts.sentence: Disability premium waiver eligibility is confirmed by a licensed physician.

facts.name: Disability Premium Waiver Until Age 65
facts.sentence: Disability premium waiver is available through age 65.

facts.name: Age 65 Waiver Transition
facts.sentence: At age 65, the normal age reduction schedule applies to disability premium waiver benefits.

facts.name: Suicide Exclusion Within First Year
facts.sentence: No life insurance benefit is payable for suicide occurring within 12 months of the effective date of coverage.

facts.name: Suicide Benefit Exclusion Post-Increase
facts.sentence: No life insurance benefit is payable for suicide occurring within 12 months of any benefit increase.

facts.name: Suicide Coverage After 12 Months
facts.sentence: Suicide is a covered cause of death after 12 months from the effective date of coverage.

facts.name: Incontestability Clause
facts.sentence: After two years from the effective date of basic coverage, Meridian may not contest coverage based on application misrepresentation.

facts.name: Incontestability Clause for Supplemental Coverage
facts.sentence: After two years from the effective date of supplemental coverage, Meridian may not contest coverage based on application misrepresentation.

facts.name: Fraud Exception to Incontestability
facts.sentence: Meridian may contest coverage due to fraud even after two years.

facts.name: Independent Incontestability Clause
facts.sentence: The incontestability clause applies independently to both basic and supplemental coverage.

facts.name: Incontestability Clause Effective Date
facts.sentence: The incontestability clause begins on the respective effective date of each type of coverage.

facts.name: No Pre-Existing Condition Exclusion
facts.sentence: There is no exclusion for pre-existing conditions under this policy.

facts.name: No Foreign Travel Exclusion
facts.sentence: There is no exclusion for foreign travel under this policy.

facts.name: No Exclusion for Research Hazards
facts.sentence: There is no exclusion for occupational hazards related to academic research under this policy.

facts.name: Laboratory Work Exclusion
facts.sentence: Occupational hazards related to academic research include laboratory work.

facts.name: No Exclusion for Research Hazards
facts.sentence: Occupational hazards related to academic research include international field study.

facts.name: Claim Filing Procedure
facts.sentence: Claims should be filed with Eastern University Human Resources.

facts.name: HR Forwarding of Claim Docs
facts.sentence: Eastern University HR forwards claim documentation to Meridian.

facts.name: Death Certificate Requirement
facts.sentence: A certified death certificate is required to file a claim.

facts.name: Claim Form Requirement
facts.sentence: A completed claim form is required to file a claim.

facts.name: Beneficiary Verification Requirement
facts.sentence: Proof of beneficiary identity is required to file a claim.

facts.name: Retiree Claim Filing Option
facts.sentence: Retiree claims may be filed directly with Meridian.

facts.name: Claim Filing Address
facts.sentence: Meridian Academic Life – Benefits Center is located at 700 University Avenue, Providence, RI 02903.

facts.name: Meridian Contact Number
facts.sentence: The phone number for Meridian Academic Life – Benefits Center is 1-877-555-3344.

facts.name: Claim Payment Timeline
facts.sentence: Meridian aims to make payments within 10 business days of receiving complete documentation.

facts.name: Governing Law Jurisdiction
facts.sentence: This insurance certificate is governed by the laws of the State of Rhode Island.

facts.name: Company Headquarters Location
facts.sentence: Meridian Academic Life Insurance Company is headquartered in Providence, Rhode Island.

facts.name: Certificate Issuance Authority
facts.sentence: The Vice President of Higher Education Programs issued this certificate.

facts.name: Certificate Issuance Date
facts.sentence: This certificate was issued on October 1, 2024.

facts.sentence: The Master Policy Number is PTL-2024-CASCADE-STATE.

facts.sentence: The Issue Date of the certificate is January 1, 2024.

facts.sentence: The Certificate Holder's name is Theodora M. Anagnos.

facts.sentence: The Certificate Holder's classification is Civil Service Grade 7, Step 4.

facts.name: Date of Birth Confirmation
facts.sentence: The Certificate Holder's date of birth is July 14, 1971.

facts.name: Date of Hire Verification
facts.sentence: The Certificate Holder's date of hire is February 28, 2005.

facts.sentence: The Policyholder is the State of Cascade, Office of Employee Benefits.

facts.name: Policyholder Location
facts.sentence: The Policyholder is located c/o Department of Administration.

facts.name: Policyholder Address Location
facts.sentence: The Policyholder’s address includes Capital City, Cascade.

facts.sentence: The coverage option selected is Basic Life (Option A – 1x Salary).

facts.name: Basic Life Coverage Amount
facts.sentence: The amount of Basic Life coverage is $82,000.

facts.name: Basic Life Coverage Amount
facts.sentence: The Basic Life coverage option provides 1 times the employee's salary.

facts.name: Basic Life Coverage Amount
facts.sentence: The Basic Life coverage amount is $82,000.

facts.name: Optional Life Coverage Amount
facts.sentence: The Optional Life coverage option provides an additional 1 times the employee's salary.

facts.name: Optional Life Coverage Amount

facts.name: Total Coverage Amount
facts.sentence: The total life insurance coverage is $164,000.

facts.sentence: George P. Anagnos is married to the insured individual.
